name: Practiced Deception
source: Inner Sea Gods pg. 221, Faiths of Corruption pg. 9
body:
Drawbacks
Practiced Deception
Source Inner Sea Gods pg. 221, Faiths of Corruption pg. 9
Category Religion
Requirement(s) Norgorber
You gain a +1 trait bonus on Disguise checks, and you can apply and remove a disguise in half the normal time.
